grounding.fiction: Everything authored from this brief remains explicitly fictional gameplay. Existing place names and game text are reference points from the shipped content model.
grounding.limits: This is an inventory of existing game content, not independently verified geographic truth. Do not infer real history, services, conditions, schedules, practices, or claims about real people. Hosts are fictional game regulars. Do not add medical or worship claims.
grounding.countryIdAuthority: For each city, the loaded CityModule.rules.country.id is authoritative. Country/territory group id uses that value, with the progression generator normalization nigeria -> ng. Country names come from rules.country.name; IDs count game identity modules, not sovereign states.
grounding.sourceScope: Per-city sourcePaths identify the city module files supplying rules, venues, regulars, and content. Story references and guide/activity wording are copied from loaded TypeScript modules.
